phoneticConvention: Approximate English respelling for English-speaking readers (CAPITALS = stressed syllable; vowels ah / eh / ee / oh / oo; j and g before e/i → kh as in Scottish 'loch'; ñ → ny; ll → y; c before e/i and z → s; r is rolled; monosyllables in capitals). Standard Castilian with seseo and yeísmo. No substitute for the audio.
reviewStatus: Written by rule from validated content; native English review recommended.
title: Plans and suggestions
goal: Talk about plans, suggest and organise an activity.

units.situation: Saying what you're going to do

model.note: 'Voy a + infinitive' = near future; don't confuse it with 'Voy a + place' (L1).

slot.native: travel to Italy in the summer

variants.study: Voy a viajar a Italia en verano.
variants.phon: VOHEE AH veeah-KHAHR AH ee-TAH-leeah EHN veh-RAH-noh
variants.native: I'm going to travel to Italy in the summer.
I'm going to change jobs.

variants.study: Voy a estudiar español este año.
variants.phon: VOHEE AH ehs-too-DEEAHR ehs-pah-NYOHL EHS-teh AH-nyoh
variants.native: I'm going to study Spanish this year.

variants.study: Voy a hacer la compra esta tarde.
variants.phon: VOHEE AH ah-SEHR LAH KOHM-prah EHS-tah TAHR-deh
variants.native: I'm going to do the shopping this afternoon.
Do you feel like going to the cinema?
Do you feel like eating out?
Do you feel like going for a walk?
Do you feel like having a drink?
Could we meet on Saturday?
Could we change the time?
Could we meet somewhere else?
Could we talk tomorrow?

variants.study: Quedamos el sábado a las diez.
variants.phon: keh-DAH-mohs EHL SAH-bah-doh AH LAHS DEEEHS
variants.native: Let's meet on Saturday at ten.
Let's meet in front of the station.

variants.study: Quedamos en la puerta del cine.
variants.phon: keh-DAH-mohs EHN LAH POOEHR-tah DEHL SEE-neh
variants.native: Let's meet at the cinema entrance.

variants.study: Quedamos el domingo por la tarde.
variants.phon: keh-DAH-mohs EHL doh-MEEN-goh POHR LAH TAHR-deh
variants.native: Let's meet on Sunday afternoon.
I can't, but tomorrow I can.

variants.study: No puedo, pero podemos quedar el viernes.
variants.phon: NOH POOEH-doh, PEH-roh poh-DEH-mohs keh-DAHR EHL VEEEHR-nehs
variants.native: I can't, but we can meet on Friday.

variants.study: No puedo, pero te llamo luego.
variants.phon: NOH POOEH-doh, PEH-roh TEH YAH-moh LOOEH-goh
variants.native: I can't, but I'll call you later.

variants.study: No puedo, pero otro día me apunto.
variants.phon: NOH POOEH-doh, PEH-roh OH-troh DEE-ah MEH ah-POON-toh
variants.native: I can't, but count me in another day.
I'd like to learn to cook.
I'd like to visit Granada.

variants.study: Me gustaría trabajar en el extranjero.
variants.phon: MEH goos-tah-REE-ah trah-bah-KHAHR EHN EHL ehks-trahn-KHEH-roh
variants.native: I'd like to work abroad.

variants.study: Me gustaría tener más tiempo libre.
variants.phon: MEH goos-tah-REE-ah teh-NEHR MAHS TEEEHM-poh LEE-breh
variants.native: I'd like to have more free time.

model.note: Set phrases to learn as they are.

variants.native: So, is that settled?
Perfect, see you on Saturday.
I'll confirm tonight.

slot.phon: SEE-kheh EHN PEEEH LOH DEH mah-NYAH-nah

variants.phon: SEE-kheh EHN PEEEH LOH DEH mah-NYAH-nah
variants.native: Is tomorrow still on?

model.note: Positive replies to learn as they are.

variants.native: OK, great!
Sounds good to me.
Yes, I'd love to.
Good idea.

units.situation: Saying what you have to do

model.note: 'Coger' (to take transport) is used in Spain; in Latin America people say 'tomar'.

variants.native: I have to work on Saturday.
I have to go to the dentist.

slot.study: coger el tren de las ocho
slot.phon: koh-KHEHR EHL TREHN DEH LAHS OH-choh

variants.study: Tengo que coger el tren de las ocho.
variants.phon: TEHN-goh KEH koh-KHEHR EHL TREHN DEH LAHS OH-choh
variants.native: I have to catch the eight o'clock train.
I have to finish a report.

variants.study: El tren sale a las nueve.
variants.phon: EHL TREHN SAH-leh AH LAHS NOOEH-veh
variants.native: The train leaves at nine.

variants.study: El tren sale dentro de diez minutos.
variants.phon: EHL TREHN SAH-leh DEHN-troh DEH DEEEHS mee-NOO-tohs
variants.native: The train leaves in ten minutes.

variants.study: El tren sale del andén dos.
variants.phon: EHL TREHN SAH-leh DEHL ahn-DEHN DOHS
variants.native: The train leaves from platform two.
The train leaves early tomorrow.

units.situation: Asking about the other person's plans

model.native: What are you going to do {s}?

variants.study: ¿Qué vas a hacer este fin de semana?
variants.phon: KEH VAHS AH ah-SEHR EHS-teh FEEN DEH seh-MAH-nah
variants.native: What are you going to do this weekend?

variants.phon: KEH VAHS AH ah-SEHR EHS-tah NOH-cheh
variants.native: What are you going to do tonight?

variants.phon: KEH VAHS AH ah-SEHR EHN vah-kah-SEEOH-nehs
variants.native: What are you going to do on holiday?

variants.study: ¿Qué vas a hacer después del trabajo?
variants.phon: KEH VAHS AH ah-SEHR dehs-POOEHS DEHL trah-BAH-khoh
variants.native: What are you going to do after work?

variants.study: La reunión es el lunes a las nueve.
variants.phon: LAH rehoo-NEEOHN EHS EHL LOO-nehs AH LAHS NOOEH-veh
variants.native: The meeting is on Monday at nine.

variants.study: La reunión es en la sala grande.
variants.phon: LAH rehoo-NEEOHN EHS EHN LAH SAH-lah GRAHN-deh
variants.native: The meeting is in the big room.
The meeting is by video call.

variants.study: La reunión es la semana que viene.
variants.phon: LAH rehoo-NEEOHN EHS LAH seh-MAH-nah KEH VEEEH-neh
variants.native: The meeting is next week.
I plan to stay at home.
I plan to go by car.
I plan to invite Marta.
I plan to come back early.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: ¿Qué vas a hacer este fin de semana?
turns.phon: KEH VAHS AH ah-SEHR EHS-teh FEEN DEH seh-MAH-nah
turns.native: What are you going to do this weekend?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Nada especial. ¿Por qué?
turns.phon: NAH-dah ehs-peh-SEEAHL. POHR KEH
turns.native: Nothing special. Why?

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: ¿Te apetece ir al cine el sábado?
turns.phon: TEH ah-peh-TEH-seh EER AHL SEE-neh EHL SAH-bah-doh
turns.native: Do you feel like going to the cinema on Saturday?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: El sábado no puedo, pero el domingo sí.
turns.phon: EHL SAH-bah-doh NOH POOEH-doh, PEH-roh EHL doh-MEEN-goh SEE
turns.native: On Saturday I can't, but on Sunday I can.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Vale. ¿Quedamos el domingo a las seis?
turns.phon: VAH-leh. keh-DAH-mohs EHL doh-MEEN-goh AH LAHS SEHEES
turns.native: OK. Shall we meet on Sunday at six?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Me parece bien. ¿Dónde?
turns.phon: MEH pah-REH-seh BEEEHN. DOHN-deh
turns.native: Sounds good to me. Where?

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: En la puerta del cine, en la plaza.
turns.phon: EHN LAH POOEHR-tah DEHL SEE-neh, EHN LAH PLAH-sah
turns.native: At the cinema entrance, on the square.

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Perfecto. Te confirmo esta noche.
turns.phon: pehr-FEHK-toh. TEH kohn-FEER-moh EHS-tah NOH-cheh
turns.native: Perfect. I'll confirm tonight.

dialogues.practice: Listen to both roles, hide one role, answer, then swap one line for a variant of your own.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Hola, Luis. La reunión es el lunes a las nueve.
turns.phon: OH-lah, LOOEES. LAH rehoo-NEEOHN EHS EHL LOO-nehs AH LAHS NOOEH-veh
turns.native: Hi, Luis. The meeting is on Monday at nine.

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: El lunes tengo que ir al dentista. ¿Podríamos cambiar la hora?
turns.phon: EHL LOO-nehs TEHN-goh KEH EER AHL dehn-TEES-tah. poh-DREE-ah-mohs kahm-BEEAHR LAH OH-rah
turns.native: On Monday I have to go to the dentist. Could we change the time?

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: ¿A las once?
turns.phon: AH LAHS OHN-seh
turns.native: At eleven?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Sí, a las once me va bien.
turns.phon: SEE, AH LAHS OHN-seh MEH VAH BEEEHN
turns.native: Yes, eleven works for me.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: ¿En la sala grande o por videollamada?
turns.phon: EHN LAH SAH-lah GRAHN-deh OH POHR vee-deh-oh-yah-MAH-dah
turns.native: In the big room or by video call?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Por videollamada, voy a trabajar desde casa.
turns.phon: POHR vee-deh-oh-yah-MAH-dah, VOHEE AH trah-bah-KHAHR DEHS-deh KAH-sah
turns.native: By video call, I'm going to work from home.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: De acuerdo, te envío el enlace.
turns.phon: DEH ah-KOOEHR-doh, TEH ehn-VEE-oh EHL ehn-LAH-seh
turns.native: All right, I'll send you the link.

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Gracias, hasta el lunes.
turns.phon: GRAH-seeahs, AHS-tah EHL LOO-nehs
turns.native: Thanks, see you on Monday.

dialogues.practice: Listen to both roles, hide one role, answer, then swap one line for a variant of your own.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Quiero viajar a Sevilla el viernes. ¿Qué tren hay?
turns.phon: KEEEH-roh veeah-KHAHR AH seh-VEE-yah EHL VEEEHR-nehs. KEH TREHN AHEE
turns.native: I want to travel to Seville on Friday. What trains are there?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Hay uno a las ocho y otro a las diez y media.
turns.phon: AHEE OO-noh AH LAHS OH-choh EE OH-troh AH LAHS DEEEHS EE MEH-deeah
turns.native: There's one at eight and another at half past ten.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Prefiero el de las ocho. ¿De qué andén sale?
turns.phon: preh-FEEEH-roh EHL DEH LAHS OH-choh. DEH KEH ahn-DEHN SAH-leh
turns.native: I prefer the eight o'clock one. Which platform does it leave from?

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Del andén tres. ¿Ida y vuelta?
turns.phon: DEHL ahn-DEHN TREHS. EE-dah EE VOOEHL-tah
turns.native: Platform three. Return ticket?

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Sí, voy a volver el domingo por la tarde.
turns.phon: SEE, VOHEE AH vohl-VEHR EHL doh-MEEN-goh POHR LAH TAHR-deh
turns.native: Yes, I'm going to come back on Sunday afternoon.

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: ¿A qué hora le gustaría volver?
turns.phon: AH KEH OH-rah LEH goos-tah-REE-ah vohl-VEHR
turns.native: What time would you like to come back?

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Sobre las seis.
turns.phon: SOH-breh LAHS SEHEES
turns.native: Around six.

turns.speaker: B
turns.study: Hay uno a las seis y cuarto. Son ochenta euros.
turns.phon: AHEE OO-noh AH LAHS SEHEES EE KOOAHR-toh. SOHN oh-CHEHN-tah EHOO-rohs
turns.native: There's one at a quarter past six. That's eighty euros.

turns.speaker: A
turns.study: Perfecto. Aquí tiene.
turns.phon: pehr-FEHK-toh. ah-KEE TEEEH-neh
turns.native: Perfect. Here you are.

dialogues.practice: Listen to both roles, hide one role, answer, then swap one line for a variant of your own.

readiness: Talk about your plans (voy a, pienso, me gustaría, tengo que), suggest an activity, set or move a time and place, accept, decline with an alternative and confirm a plan.
